photos.name: field-silver-sky
photos.alt: A silver-blue eucalyptus growing in an open field bed, its branches reaching across a bright sky.

photos.name: variety-silver
photos.alt: Dense silver-blue eucalyptus foliage, the round leaves set in opposite pairs along every stem.

photos.name: variety-pink
photos.alt: A eucalyptus bush carrying pink and bronze new growth at the tips of its green leaves.

photos.name: field-silver-row
photos.alt: A young eucalyptus plant in a field bed of red soil, with further rows running away behind it.

photos.name: cut-stems
photos.alt: Freshly cut eucalyptus stems laid against a timber wall, cut ends turned to face the same way.

photos.name: sorting
photos.alt: Cut eucalyptus being sorted into bunches on a bench, with the stem ends gathered and aligned.

photos.name: bunch-tied
photos.alt: A tied bunch of eucalyptus resting on card, its stems trimmed level across the base.

photos.name: shed-rows
photos.alt: Cut eucalyptus held in quantity inside the packing shed, banked in rows against a timber wall.

photos.name: shed-wide
photos.alt: The packing shed seen wide, filled with cut eucalyptus waiting to be graded and tied.

photos.name: stem-single
photos.alt: One eucalyptus stem laid out flat, showing the full length and the regular pairing of its leaves.
